changelog: SteamVR Null Driver Mouse & Keyboard Access v0.1.14
features: SteamVR Null Driver Mouse & Keyboard Access: Full native keyboard (WASD/keys) and mouse (camera look/clicks/wheel) support when using SteamVR driver_null without physical VR motion controllers

User32 Focus Spoofing Detours: Hooked GetForegroundWindow, GetActiveWindow, GetCursorPos, and SetCursor ensuring games (including Unreal Engine) maintain active input processing even if SteamVR mirror or null driver window is in front

Focus Preservation Window Message Filter: Hooked WndProc suppresses deactivation and focus-loss signals (WM_ACTIVATEAPP, WM_ACTIVATE, WM_NCACTIVATE, WM_KILLFOCUS) preventing game engines from disabling cursor capture or unbinding inputs
Smart Low-Level Background Forwarding: Low-level keyboard and mouse hooks seamlessly bridge background strokes to the game window when focusing external VR mirrors
Native KBM Fallback Guard: Prevents virtual gamepad emulation from locking games into controller mode when VR controllers are not active, keeping mouse cursor visible in menus
fixes: Fixed SteamVR null driver users unable to use mouse and keyboard in Hogwarts Legacy and other injected games
Resolved Unreal Engine input drop when focus shifted to SteamVR Headset Window or external mirror
Enabled full cursor navigation in menus and infinite mouselook in 3D camera gameplay
